snippet.title: Bootstrap Island Major Update 4 - Riverlands Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Survivors, our biggest update yet is live! 

Major Update 4: Riverlands introduces a vast, untamed biome that’s larger than all previous areas combined. To reach the Riverlands, you’ll first have to defeat the Jungle Overlord in his Dark Lair... but what lies beyond is a lush new world - with its own dangers, of course.

🐊 Key Features of Major Update 4 in Bootstrap Island:

1. The Riverlands Biome – A massive new region filled with rivers, waterfalls, and secrets. The largest area yet!
2. Unlimited Fresh Water – With flowing streams and waterfalls, thirst is no longer your main concern - but danger still lurks.
3. Electric Eel – A deadly aquatic predator capable of stunning or killing with powerful electric shocks. Stay sharp in the water.
4. Alligator-like Predator – A stealthy riverbank ambusher that strikes fast and hard. One misstep could be your last.
5. Musket Sling – Carry your musket hands-free! This survival upgrade unlocks after several days, showing your hard-earned experience.
6. New Tropical Fruits – Discover powerful, nourishing fruits found only in the Riverlands.

Explore the highly realistic survival game on Steam (PCVR)! https://store.steampowered.com/app/1942110/Bootstrap_Island/

🌴Join the survivors on our Discord: (https://discord.com/invite/x48uSXbUyv)

#VR #Bootstrapisland #survival
